games.name: Aces and Kings
games.note: Empty foundations that build in opposite directions, four single-card spaces the stock refills by itself, and a waste that gets one pass.

games.name: Australian Patience
games.note: Yukon-style group moves and same-suit columns, paired with a draw-one stock that cannot recycle its waste.

games.name: Baker's Game
games.note: FreeCell's free cells, foundations and staged run moves, with one word changed: the columns build in the same suit.

games.name: Carpet
games.note: Twenty single-card spaces that accept only from the waste, over a stock that draws once and never recycles.

games.name: Double Klondike
games.note: Klondike's stock, waste and turn-up columns stretched over two decks: eight repeated foundations and a nine-column diagonal deal.

games.name: Fourteen Out
games.note: A discard that builds by sum, taking pairs that total fourteen, and a win that asks for empty columns rather than full foundations.

games.name: Putt Putt with Jokers
games.note: Golf's one foundation with ranks that wrap from King to Ace, and wild Jokers.

games.name: Russian Solitaire
games.note: Yukon's diagonal deal and unrestricted face-up group moves, with columns that build in the same suit.

games.name: Simple Simon
games.note: Spider's same-suit group moves and self-banking runs, with all 52 cards dealt face up and no stock to draw from.

games.name: Spiderette
games.note: Spider's row deal, same-suit runs and self-banking foundations, set out on Klondike's seven-column table with one deck.

games.name: Sultan
games.note: Named foundations laid out as a portrait, a centre card that accepts nothing, Kings that wrap round to Ace, and a stock that recycles twice.

builtIns.name: Klondike
builtIns.note: The classic layout: a stock that draws one card and recycles its waste, four foundations, and seven columns dealt diagonally one step at a time.

builtIns.name: FreeCell
builtIns.note: Four free cells that hold one card each, alternating-colour columns, and staged moves that limit how many cards a run may carry.

builtIns.name: Spider (1 Suit)
builtIns.note: Eight foundations that take only a finished King-to-Ace run, columns that lift descending runs, and a stock that deals a row while no column is empty.

builtIns.name: Yukon
builtIns.note: Columns that build in alternating colours but lift any face-up group, in order or not, over a diagonal deal of hidden cards.

builtIns.name: Forty Thieves
builtIns.note: Two decks, eight foundations, and ten same-suit columns that move one card at a time, fed by a stock that never recycles.

builtIns.name: Golf
builtIns.note: One foundation that takes a card a rank up or down, a stock that draws straight onto it, and a loss when no move is left.

builtIns.name: La Belle Lucie
builtIns.note: Eighteen fans that give up only their top card, one named rule shared by all of them, and two redeals that gather, shuffle and deal again.

builtIns.name: Canfield
builtIns.note: Foundations whose starting rank is set by the deal and wrap from King to Ace, and a reserve that refills an emptied column by itself.

builtIns.name: Beleaguered Castle
builtIns.note: Aces placed on the foundations before the deal, and eight columns that fan out to the left and right and move one card at a time.

builtIns.name: Bisley
builtIns.note: Aces placed before the deal, King foundations that build down to meet them, and columns that build up or down in suit.

builtIns.name: Calculation
builtIns.note: Four foundations that count up by one, two, three and four, each seeded with a named card, and waste piles that take cards only from the stock.

builtIns.name: Eight Off
builtIns.note: FreeCell with eight cells, same-suit columns, and a rule that only a King may start an empty column.

builtIns.name: Seahaven Towers
builtIns.note: Ten same-suit columns that only a King may start, four cells, and staged moves over a deal that leaves two cards in the cells.

builtIns.name: Black Hole
builtIns.note: One foundation seeded with the Ace of Spades that takes a card up or down with wrap, and seventeen fans that give up only their top card.

builtIns.name: Scorpion
builtIns.note: Columns that lift any face-up group, in order or not, and a stock of three cards that deals once, onto the first three columns.

builtIns.name: Flower Garden
builtIns.note: A bouquet of sixteen cards that play in any order, and six beds that build down regardless of suit.
